value.deck: Imagine having an artificial intelligence assistant for coding right inside your team's chat app, making it simpler for everyone to get help with their work.
shortVersion: GitHub Copilot is like an artificial intelligence (AI) helper that assists people with writing computer code. Slack is a popular chat application where teams talk and work together. Now, GitHub Copilot has a new way to work directly inside Slack.

This new setup lets teams talk to "Copilot agents" right in Slack. Think of these agents as smart bots that can understand your questions about coding and offer suggestions or solutions. This makes it easier for everyone on a team to get quick development assistance.

This change is significant because many teams already use Slack for their daily communication. Bringing AI help into their existing chat makes it much simpler to use, lowering the barrier for more people to benefit from AI-powered coding help.
value.plainLanguage: An AI helper for computer coding, called GitHub Copilot, can now assist teams directly within their Slack chat app, making it easier to get help.

keyTerms.meaning: An artificial intelligence (AI) tool that helps computer programmers write code faster and with fewer mistakes.
A widely used chat application that allows teams to communicate, share files, and work together in organized conversations.
These are like smart computer programs that can understand requests and perform specific tasks, acting as helpful assistants.
Getting help or support with the process of creating or improving computer programs and software.

value.whyItMatters: This matters because many teams already use chat apps like Slack to talk and work together every day. By putting an AI coding helper directly into these chats, it becomes much simpler for everyone on the team to get quick assistance, even if they're not AI experts. It makes powerful AI tools more accessible to more people.
